parameters.query:
with p as (select $1::jsonb as j),
src as (
  select nullif(r->>'ws','')            as ws,
         (r->>'date')::date             as report_date,
         (r->>'invites_sent')::int      as invites_sent,
         (r->>'sched_today')::int       as schedule_today,
         (r->>'sched_tomorrow')::int    as schedule_tomorrow,
         (r->>'sched_day_after')::int   as schedule_day_after
  from p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j) r
),
mapped as (
  select cs_a.client_id, cs_a.sequencer_id, src.*
  from src
  join public.client_sequencers cs_b on cs_b.external_workspace_id = src.ws
  join public.sequencers        s_b  on s_b.id = cs_b.sequencer_id and s_b.key = 'emailbison'
  join public.client_sequencers cs_a on cs_a.client_id = cs_b.client_id
  join public.sequencers        s_a  on s_a.id = cs_a.sequencer_id and s_a.key = 'aimfox'
  where src.invites_sent is not null
),
ins as (
  insert into public.sequencer_daily_stats (
    id, client_id, sequencer_id, profile_id, report_date,
    invites_sent, invites_accepted, schedule_today, schedule_tomorrow, schedule_day_after, created_at)
  select gen_random_uuid(), m.client_id, m.sequencer_id, '__workspace_total__', m.report_date,
         m.invites_sent,
         null,                       -- acceptances are not in the sheet; NULL means not measured
         coalesce(m.schedule_today, 0), coalesce(m.schedule_tomorrow, 0), coalesce(m.schedule_day_after, 0),
         now()
  from mapped m
  on conflict (client_id, sequencer_id, profile_id, report_date) do update set
    invites_sent       = excluded.invites_sent,
    schedule_today     = excluded.schedule_today,
    schedule_tomorrow  = excluded.schedule_tomorrow,
    schedule_day_after = excluded.schedule_day_after
  returning id
)
select (select count(*) from src)    as candidate_rows,
       (select count(*) from mapped) as mapped_rows,
       (select count(*) from ins)    as written,
       (select count(distinct ws) from src)    as workspaces_in_sheet,
       (select count(distinct ws) from mapped) as workspaces_mapped;
